title: Policies for information security
repo_note: Repo is an engineering rulebook, not an approved ISMS policy set.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
repo_note: Names an owner for approvals; no security roles defined.

title: Segregation of duties
repo_note: Owner-only overrides, read-only plan role, operator/tenant split; no formal duty matrix.

title: Threat intelligence
repo_note: Advisory feeds and release-age wait; no threat-intel collection or analysis process.

title: Information security in project management
repo_note: Security boundaries need ADRs; per-change checklist covers permissions, leaks, tenancy.

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
repo_note: Cloud resources and data stores declared in code; no owners or device inventory.

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
repo_note: Production data-blind and secret-handling rules; no general acceptable-use rules.

title: Classification of information
repo_note: Mandatory per-endpoint personal-data flag; no general classification scheme.

title: Labelling of information
repo_note: Endpoint metadata carries the label; global tables carry a written reason.

title: Information transfer
repo_note: TLS, mail authentication, no data in URLs; no transfer agreements.

title: Access control
repo_note: Three-layer authorization, least privilege, non-code tenant barrier.

title: Identity management
repo_note: Managed identity for users; workforce identity lifecycle absent.

title: Authentication information
repo_note: No password handling; hashed single-use links and tokens; secrets never in chat.

title: Access rights
repo_note: Provisioning by admin and reviewed permissions; no periodic review or removal.

title: Information security in supplier relationships
repo_note: Package admission vetting; no supplier risk process for SaaS vendors.

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
repo_note: Approval, install scripts off, release age, SHA/digest/hash pinning.

title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
repo_note: Updater and advisories watched; vendor URI checks manual; no supplier service reviews.

title: Information security for use of cloud services
repo_note: Cloud configuration well covered; no acquisition, shared-responsibility or exit process.

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
repo_note: Request ids aid triage; no incident plan, roles or runbook.

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
repo_note: Errors are reported; no rule to classify security events.

title: Response to information security incidents
repo_note: Leaked-secret rotation procedure only.

title: Learning from information security incidents
repo_note: Incident lessons trigger an ADR; no post-incident review rule.

title: Information security during disruption
repo_note: Pause lever and announced emergency applies; no disruption plan.

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
repo_note: Per-customer backups, deletion protection; no RTO/RPO or DR test.

title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
repo_note: External legal constraints are recorded as ADRs.

title: Intellectual property rights
repo_note: Package vetting omits licence checks.

title: Protection of records
repo_note: Retention on logs, deletion protection, audited operator actions; no records schedule.

title: Privacy and protection of PII
repo_note: Strong technical PII rules; no DPIA, lawful basis or retention schedule.

title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
repo_note: Guard tests enforce many rules automatically; no compliance review.

title: Documented operating procedures
repo_note: Production scripts, rotation and runner docs required; not comprehensive.

title: Information security awareness, education and training
repo_note: Agent working rules train the AI agent; no human training.

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
Remote working
repo_note: Local stack needs no credentials; no remote-working controls.

title: Information security event reporting
repo_note: Automated error reporting only; no human reporting channel.

title: Physical security perimeters
repo_note: Cloud provider responsibility for data centres.

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
Clear desk and clear screen
repo_note: Recorded videos show only project-owned test data.

title: Storage media
repo_note: Runner workspace secrets removed; keys deleted after use.

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
User endpoint devices
repo_note: Tokens in mobile secure storage, keys git-ignored; no laptop/BYOD controls.

title: Privileged access rights
repo_note: Audited operator role, no standing privilege; no human privileged-account or MFA rule.

title: Information access restriction
repo_note: Role, ownership, field filtering, tenant-prefix scoping with isolation tests.

title: Access to source code
repo_note: Release via deliberate merge, roles trust branches; no repo access or branch-protection rule.

title: Secure authentication
repo_note: Managed hosted sign-in, PKCE, edge verification; MFA optional, no passkeys.

title: Capacity management
repo_note: Quotas recorded, pagination up front, artifact storage quota.

title: Protection against malware
repo_note: Supply-chain malware paths closed; no endpoint or upload scanning.

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
repo_note: New advisories blocked; no SLA for existing ones, runtime/OS patching or pentest.

title: Configuration management
repo_note: All config in IaC, pipeline-applied, guard tests pin settings.

title: Information deletion
repo_note: Deletion list written with feature and tested; TTL with read-side expiry check.

title: Data masking
repo_note: Redaction in exports, data-blind production ops, identifiers-only logs.

title: Data leakage prevention
repo_note: Strong app-level leak rules; no egress or mail DLP.

title: Information backup
repo_note: Per-customer backups; PITR optional; no backup policy or restore test.

title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
repo_note: No availability-zone or region redundancy rule.

title: Logging
repo_note: Structured logs with retention, audited operator; no cloud API audit trail or log integrity.

title: Monitoring activities
repo_note: Error reporting and spend alerts; no security anomaly monitoring.

title: Clock synchronization
repo_note: Instants UTC on the wire; clock source left to provider.

title: Use of privileged utility programs
repo_note: Production scripts: dry-run default, target verified, idempotent.

title: Installation of software on operational systems
repo_note: Only the pipeline deploys; new dependencies need named approval.

title: Networks security
repo_note: Edge firewall and TLS; no network-layer rules for VPCs or runners.

title: Security of network services
repo_note: TLS minimum, HTTPS redirect, throttling; no service-level security agreements.

title: Segregation of networks
repo_note: Separate accounts per environment and optionally per customer.

title: Web filtering
repo_note: No staff web-filtering control; arguably workforce IT.

title: Use of cryptography
repo_note: TLS, default encryption, CMK for tokens; no key management or rotation policy.

title: Secure development life cycle
repo_note: Gated CI, ADRs, checklists and supply-chain controls.

title: Application security requirements
repo_note: Required role and privacy declarations, input validation.

title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
repo_note: Dependency rule, edge enforcement, layered non-code barriers.

title: Secure coding
repo_note: Parameterised queries, no silent catch, no dev shims, typed wire values.

title: Security testing in development and acceptance
repo_note: Role and isolation tests, guards; no SAST, DAST or pentest.

title: Outsourced development
repo_note: AI agent bound by working rules; no outsourced-supplier controls.

title: Separation of development, test and production environments
repo_note: Local simulators; separate pre-prod and prod accounts.

title: Change management
repo_note: Plan review, owner-approved release, per-action confirmation, ADRs.

title: Test information
repo_note: Tests seed own data via API; project-owned test values only.

title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
repo_note: Data-blind, dry-run production operations; no audit-test planning.

title: Context of the organization (4.1-4.4; Amd 1:2024 climate relevance)
Planning: risk assessment, risk treatment, Statement of Applicability, objectives (6.1-6.3)
repo_note: Repo has no threat model or risk register; would need one.

title: Support: resources, competence, awareness, communication, documented information (7.1-7.5)
repo_note: ADRs and rules files are documented information.

title: Operation: planning, risk assessment and treatment execution (8.1-8.3)
Performance evaluation: monitoring, internal audit, management review (9.1-9.3)
repo_note: Guard tests give continuous measurement evidence.

title: Improvement: continual improvement, nonconformity and corrective action (10.1-10.2)
repo_note: Lessons become ADRs.
